title: Nuria's mission won · two lights, the ánima counter and Papagato's banner
description: docs/quests/nuria.md § Beats 5 and § The lights: Vertitrón beaten, everyone back at Nuria's door. Two lights leave Nuria and Uri (Nil in his arms) and go one into Gerard and one into Aitor; the ánima counter beside the menus shows up with the first and counts each as it goes in, up to 2. Then the banner ÁNIMA DESBLOQUEADA · Papagato, a cream cushion card in cat-orange with a trail of paw prints walking up onto it: Papagato is theirs for good; going, the cat walks on up off the card, its prints fading behind it the oldest first, and the card fades away.

steps.eval: window.gerard.story.handle({ type: 'interact', id: 'talk-nuria' }); window.gerard.storyEvent({ type: 'battle', won: true, encounter: 'uri-vertigo', worn: ['papagato'] })

steps.caption: The lights: Nuria flashes and a light rises out of her chest
It arcs into Gerard; then Uri's (Nil in his arms) into Aitor
Nuria's light is in: the ánima counter shows up beside the menus, 1 ánima
Uri's into Aitor: 2 ánimas, two and no more
ÁNIMA DESBLOQUEADA · Papagato: theirs for good, a cat's paw prints walking up onto the card

steps.eval: const b = document.querySelector('.anima-banner'); const c = b.cloneNode(true); c.hidden = false; c.dataset.leaving = 'true'; c.dataset.still = 'true'; b.after(c); window.__still = t => c.getAnimations({ subtree: true }).forEach(a => { a.pause(); a.currentTime = a.animationName === 'banner-in' ? 600 : t; }); window.__still(300)

steps.caption: Going (held still here, step by step): the cat sets off again, its first prints fade, the oldest first, and the next ones step up the card
The cat steps up off the card's top edge while the card fades, smaller and out of focus
The card has gone; the last prints, out in the street, fade after it
Nuria, Uri and Nil together at the door; Uri's eyes are his own again
